entries.source: Lorenz Fries, Hohe Registratur, entry 5723, Standbuch 1012, Folio: 446r, Schreiber: Lorenz Fries
entries.german: desgleichen wie Kunigund besserm anselm von Rosenbergs ritters eheliche dochter vnd Hans besserer ir hauswirt den obuerlauten vertrag ratificirn vnd brerstigen actum mitwochen nach Sant Margarethen tagk anno 1487 stet Registrirt 4 Contractum Rudolfi fo. 22 Kommentar: Der Vertrag bezieht sich auf den vorherigen Eintrag.
entries.english: Likewise, Kunigunde Besserer, the legitimate daughter of Anselm von Rosenberg, Ritter, and Hans Besserer, her husband, ratified and confirmed the aforementioned agreement. Done on Wednesday after St Margaret’s Day, 1487. Registered in the fourth register of Rudolf’s contracts, fol. 22. Editorial note: The agreement refers to the preceding entry.

facts.content: ratified and confirmed the preceding agreement with her husband Hans Besserer.
